map.选择无损检测方法(RT/UT/MT/PT)，输入缺陷参数，按NB/T 47013: Choose a non-destructive testing method (RT/UT/MT/PT), enter the defect parameters, and rate the weld quality level to NB/T 47013
map.焊缝缺陷评定（NB/T 47013）：按缺陷长度与评定区长度之比分级，Ⅰ 级不允: Weld defect rating (NB/T 47013): graded by the ratio of defect length to evaluation area length; Class I allows no linear defects, Classes II to IV are judged by the defect length ratio and the per-defect limit; round defects are converted to point counts, and anything beyond Class III is judged non-conforming; RT, UT, MT and PT each have their own acceptance tables.
map.按检测方法与缺陷尺寸评定焊缝质量等级（Ⅰ~Ⅳ 级），判断是否允许验收。: Rate the weld quality level (Class I to IV) from the testing method and defect dimensions, to decide whether acceptance is allowed.
map.针对对接或角焊缝选择适宜的无损检测方法（表面 vs 内部缺陷）。: Pick a suitable non-destructive testing method for butt welds or fillet welds (surface vs internal defects).
map.按 NB/T 47013 给出缺陷评定依据，辅助返修决策。: Give the defect rating basis per NB/T 47013 to support rework decisions.
map.射线检测 RT：圆形缺陷长径 cd 与条状缺陷长度 sd（mm），比值 = sd: Radiographic testing RT: with round defect major diameter cd and linear defect length sd (mm), the ratio = sd/plate thickness. Class I: cd≤2, sd≤6 and ratio≤0.25; Class II: cd≤4, sd≤12, ratio≤0.5; Class III: cd≤6, sd≤20, ratio≤0.8; otherwise Class IV. Ultrasonic testing UT: Class I sd≤8 and cd≤3; Class II sd≤15 and cd≤6; Class III sd≤25 and cd≤10; otherwise Class IV. Magnetic particle MT and penetrant PT: Class I cd≤1.5 and sd≤3; Class II cd≤3 and sd≤6; Class III cd≤6 and sd≤12; otherwise Class IV. Classes I and II pass; Classes III and IV need rework followed by re-inspection.
map.板厚 20 mm 对接焊缝，RT 检出圆形缺陷 3 mm、条状缺陷 10 mm：: A 20 mm plate butt weld tested by RT finds a 3 mm round defect and a 10 mm linear defect: ratio = 10/20 = 0.5, which satisfies Class II (cd≤4, sd≤12, ratio≤0.5), so it is judged acceptable. If the linear defect were 18 mm: ratio 0.9, above the Class III limit of 0.8, so it is rated Class IV and needs rework. For surface testing by MT/PT: a 2 mm round defect and a 4 mm linear defect are Class II and acceptable.
map.RT 和 UT 怎么选？: How to choose between RT and UT?
map.两者都检内部缺陷：RT 有影像记录、对体积型缺陷（气孔、夹渣）直观；UT 对面积: Both detect internal defects: RT produces an imaging record and shows volumetric defects (porosity, slag) directly; UT is more sensitive to planar defects (lack of fusion, cracks), has no radiation and can measure thickness, but relies heavily on operator experience. Critical welds often use the two in a complementary way.
map.MT 和 PT 有什么区别？: What is the difference between MT and PT?
map.MT 只适用于铁磁性材料，可检出表面及近表面缺陷；PT 适用于任何材料（含不锈钢: MT applies only to ferromagnetic materials and can reveal surface and near-surface defects; PT works on any material (including stainless steel and non-ferrous metals) but can only detect surface-breaking defects. Neither can detect internal defects.
map.本工具依据NB/T 47013《承压设备无损检测》标准进行焊缝质量等级评定: This tool rates weld quality levels in accordance with the NB/T 47013 standard for non-destructive testing of pressure equipment
map.RT按圆形缺陷和条状缺陷分级；UT按波幅区和指示长度分级；MT/PT按磁痕/痕迹: RT is graded by round defects and linear defects; UT by wave-amplitude zone and indication length; MT/PT by magnetic trace and indication size
map.Ⅰ级为最高质量，Ⅱ级合格，Ⅲ级有条件合格，Ⅳ级不合格需返修: Class I is the highest quality, Class II passes, Class III passes conditionally, Class IV fails and needs rework
map.实际评定应考虑缺陷间距、群缺陷和综合评级: Practical ratings should also consider defect spacing, cluster defects and the overall rating
map.检测人员须持有特种设备无损检测相应方法II级以上资格证书: Inspectors must hold a special-equipment non-destructive testing certificate of Level II or above for the relevant method
